name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1894: The numbers I reported for his set-piece sweep were from the previous proposal: the file was written at 00:47 and I read it minutes earlier while the sweep was still folding and gating. The real answer is eleven of the thirteen cleared rather than six, thirty-six set rows rather than twenty-eight, and every one of those rows carries the game own First Found date. The surface had the same blindness I did - the engine has stamped every result for versions and nothing rendered it, so a proposal from an hour ago and one from last week looked identical. The console says how old it is now, and whether it came from disk.
